name: PUPPY
source:
Eleanor was walking home from work when she stumbled upon a small dog in cardboard box. 

Its such a nice and friendly dog that they bond easily,  ̶b̶u̶t̶ ̶w̶i̶t̶h̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶d̶i̶s̶a̶p̶p̶e̶a̶r̶a̶n̶c̶e̶s̶ ̶t̶h̶a̶t̶ ̶h̶a̶v̶e̶ ̶s̶t̶a̶r̶t̶e̶d̶ ̶h̶a̶p̶p̶e̶n̶i̶n̶g̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶a̶r̶e̶a̶,̶ ̶s̶o̶ ̶E̶l̶e̶a̶n̶o̶r̶-̶

 ̶E̶l̶e̶a̶n̶o̶r̶ ̶i̶s̶ ̶f̶i̶n̶e̶.̶ ̶E̶l̶e̶a̶n̶o̶r̶ ̶i̶s̶ ̶p̶r̶o̶t̶e̶c̶t̶e̶d̶.̶

PUPPY is a short kinetic novel about a girl who adopts a stray dog and they live their everyday lives together, happily. Together forever. 

[From [url=https://marionette.itch.io/puppy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃莉诺下班回家时偶然发现了一只装在纸板箱里的小狗。

这是一只非常友善的狗，它们很容易建立联系，̶b̶u̶t̶ ̶w̶i̶t̶h̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶d̶i̶s̶a̶p̶p̶e̶a̶r̶a̶n̶c̶e̶s̶ ̶t̶h̶a̶t̶ ̶h̶a̶v̶e̶ ̶s̶t̶a̶r̶t̶e̶d̶ ̶h̶a̶p̶p̶e̶n̶i̶n̶g̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶a̶r̶e̶a̶,̶ ̶s̶o̶ ̶E̶l̶e̶a̶n̶o̶r̶-̶

 ̶E̶l̶e̶a̶n̶o̶r̶ ̶i̶s̶ ̶f̶i̶n̶e̶.̶ ̶E̶l̶e̶a̶n̶o̶r̶ ̶i̶s̶ ̶p̶r̶o̶t̶e̶c̶t̶e̶d̶.̶

《PUPPY》是一部动态短篇小说，讲述了一个女孩收养了一只流浪狗，她们幸福地过着日常生活的故事。永远在一起。

[来自[url=https://marionette.itch.io/puppy]Itch.io[/url]]
